SELECT p.category,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN l.qty END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
                THEN l.qty * l.unit_price * (100 - l.discount_pct) / 100.0 END)
FROM cube_demo.shop_order_lines l
JOIN cube_demo.shop_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN cube_demo.shop_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
